name: Aumis Pup
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Aumis Pup in Tirol Discover the magic of Tirol with Aumis Pup, your charming and cozy retreat nestled in the heart of the Alps.
beschreibung: The Aumis Pup in Stubaital is a cozy pub with authentic ambiance and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Locals and visitors alike gather here to enjoy a cool beer or a fine glass of wine as the evening unfolds. The menu features classic pub specialties and regional delicacies, all freshly prepared. The rustic yet inviting interior, with comfortable seating, creates a relaxed vibe that invites you to stay awhile. Whether you're looking for an after-work drink, a cozy gathering with friends, or simply want to soak in the lively atmosphere, the Aumis Pup is the go-to spot for convivial evenings in Stubaital.
